scientific_integrity: Analytic hypergeometric couplings prove all-size conditional stochastic monotonicity. Exhaustive exact small cases are corroborative only; prior covariance structure is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Finite-sample pairwise stochastic order only; no statement about global multivariate association, strict nonlinear covariance in degenerate cases, or uniform rather than Fisher–Yates table measure. Historical equivalence in older multivariate hypergeometric literature remains possible.
title: Signed stochastic regression of cell counts in Fisher–Yates contingency tables
